# Native development

Statistic runs as a macOS process while the optional Docker `statistics`
profile supplies ClickHouse. Shared Docker NATS supplies JetStream. Statistic
does not require PostgreSQL, MinIO, or another application service at startup.

## Shared infrastructure

From `learning-platform-infrastructure`, start the optional profile only when
working on Statistic:

```sh
make native-infra-up PROFILE=statistics
make native-infra-check PROFILE=statistics
```

The default native infrastructure remains free of ClickHouse. The shared NATS
bootstrap owns the `LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS` JetStream stream with the
`learning.activity.interesting` subject.

## Native process

```sh
task migrate:native
task run:native
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18090/internal/health
```

`scripts/native_config.py` reads the approved infrastructure dotenv file
without printing its values. It provides only topology values:

| Dependency | Native value |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP listener | `127.0.0.1:18090` by default; override `STATISTIC_NATIVE_HTTP_PORT` |
| ClickHouse native TCP | `127.0.0.1:19000`, from the optional `statistics` profile |
| NATS / JetStream | `nats://127.0.0.1:4222` |

Use `LW_INFRA_ENV_FILE` to select the approved infrastructure dotenv file.
The adapter accepts `STATISTIC_NATIVE_*` endpoint overrides. It leaves Docker
defaults untouched and never prints credentials or tokens.

`task migrate:native` invokes the repository-owned `cmd/migrate` command and
the same ordered `migrations/*.up.sql` files used by Docker. Current migration
SQL is idempotent (`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`) but has no migration ledger;
do not use the manual down SQL against retained data.

With the native process running, use:

```sh
task test:native-integration
```

Provide `STATISTIC_NATIVE_INTERNAL_TOKEN` to the test process with the same
private value as the running service's `STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN`. The test also
accepts `STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN` directly. Pass the token through the approved
private environment without printing it or placing it in shell arguments.

The proof rejects absent and incorrect `X-Internal-Token` headers, writes a
unique telemetry fixture through the public HTTP contract, and checks both the
task summary and authenticated internal learning-session summary. It verifies
positive capped active time, all event counts, and student/session isolation,
then checks the `LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS` JetStream event and deletes only its
exact ClickHouse rows and NATS message. It requires no LLM.

## Standalone Docker path

```sh
task up
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:28090/internal/health
task down
```

The standalone Compose topology now includes ClickHouse, JetStream NATS, and a
one-shot bootstrap for the same `LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS` stream. It retains
the `clickhouse-data` and `nats-data` volumes when stopped. Host ports are
loopback-only: application `28090`, ClickHouse native TCP `29000`, ClickHouse
HTTP `28123`, NATS `24222`, and NATS monitor `28222` by default. Override the
corresponding `STATISTIC_DOCKER_*_PORT` variables if required.
